name: codexa
description: Selective Codex-native codebase intelligence for ambiguous, cross-cutting, or high-risk repository work.

interface.shortDescription: Use Codexa selectively when source inspection alone is not enough.
interface.longDescription: Codexa adds repository-focused search, change planning, dependency context, and verification guidance for ambiguous or high-risk work. Exact local tasks stay source-first with zero Codexa calls, and normal bounded tasks usually use no more than two.
defaultPrompt: Use Codexa only if this task needs repository context beyond exact source inspection; normal bounded work usually needs no more than two calls.
If the target is unclear, use one Codexa search and stop discovery when raw results are sufficient; do not automatically chain context calls.
For a materially risky edit, save a Codexa change plan and request one final post-edit review unless a true completion/Stop gate owns that review.

This Codex plugin ships no completion hook; edit-only hooks from a separate Codexa init do not suppress final review. Only an ambiguous, materially risky task without a completion/Stop gate warrants the three-call search, plan, review exception.
